players.product: Outsourced wafer test and package test for system semiconductors (SoC, CIS, MCU, smart card IC)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 revenue KRW 157,755,031 thousand - wafer test KRW 144,604,608 thousand, package test KRW 11,369,922 thousand, die preparation KRW 1,780,501 thousand; exports (indirect, zero-rated) KRW 126,198,661 thousand. Q2 2026 revenue KRW 80,925,531,000 and operating profit KRW 9,850,780,000 (H1 operating profit KRW 15,334,512,000). Wafer test makes up most of test revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 157,755,031 thousand; Q2 revenue KRW 80,925,531,000; Q2 operating profit KRW 9,850,780,000

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: wafer test utilisation 57.8% in H1 2026 (45.5% in 2025, 61.9% in 2024); package test utilisation 58.2%; die preparation utilisation 8.9%. Capacity is measured as full production over 720 hours per month.

Half-year report investment plan (estimates, may change): semiconductor test equipment acquisitions of KRW 190,877 million (04-28-2026 to 10-30-2026) and KRW 205,308 million (10-15-2025 to 03-31-2027), both to meet rising test demand; new plant facilities KRW 230,342 million (07-04-2024 to 11-30-2027). H1 2026 cash spent on property, plant and equipment KRW 70,982,185,000.
quarterly_data.figure: test equipment KRW 190,877 million and KRW 205,308 million; plant KRW 230,342 million

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report customer concentration: the company's customers are mostly large semiconductor companies; one unnamed large semiconductor company (over 10% of revenue) accounted for KRW 149,605,000 thousand of H1 2026 revenue (KRW 127,433,000 thousand in H1 2025).
quarterly_data.figure: KRW 149,605,000 thousand from one customer in H1 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report subsequent event: on 07-09-2026 the board decided to discontinue the die preparation (DP) business to focus on core competencies and improve profitability; its assets and liabilities are to be sold or liquidated.
Customer SemiFive (associate, 1.95% stake): related-party revenue from SemiFive KRW 1,670,946 thousand in H1 2026.

connects_to.relationship: wafer test and test-program development for Samsung Electronics system semiconductors

contracts.signal: Half-year report: Doosan Tesna's R&D centre develops wafer-test and package-test programs for products of Samsung Electronics as well as several fabless companies; the company's customers are mostly large semiconductor companies.

Doosan Tesna.why: Korean outsourced test house for system semiconductors (wafer test is most of revenue); its test revenue rises with foundry / system-chip volumes, including Samsung Electronics products.
Doosan Tesna.evidence: Doosan Tesna Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026): R&D centre develops test programs for Samsung Electronics and several fabless companies' products; H1 2026 wafer test revenue KRW 144,604,608 thousand.
